subject: P9-HB1: ScheduleWakeup contract substrate (script + harness scheduler API)
description: Implement shared ScheduleWakeup semantics matching Claude: cancel prior wake for session, sleep delaySeconds, re-prompt same session. Add adapters/common/schedule-wakeup.sh (cancel|arm) with pidfiles under $ORCH_DATA/wake/<session>.pid. Add lib/schedule-wakeup.js shared helpers. Extend lib/harness.js scheduler contract: armWakeup({ session, delaySeconds, reason, prompt }) and cancelWakeup({ session }). Claude adapter documents native delegation; no MCP duplicate.
